prompt: doxygen \image command inline option caption behavior HTML
answer:
Use the `inline` option in braces:

```text
\image{inline} html image.png "caption"
```

In HTML, an inline image is placed “in the line,” and its caption is shown as a tooltip. The caption is ignored for other output formats.

The `{inline}` syntax was introduced in Doxygen 1.8.15; older versions will not support it.
